lines.emptyBody: Confirmed orders with garments still to make show here.
lines.noMatchBody: Clear the filters to see every open line.

keys.history: Promise history of the focused line
keys.close: Close a popover or a dialog

held.noManage: You can read promises, not change them (planning.promise.manage).
held.mayNot: This line cannot be re-promised now (it shipped, or you cannot see its order).
held.nothingMoved: Give at least one size a new day.
held.sizeProblem: A size’s new day needs a look (said in its row).
held.noReason: Pick the reason the customer will read.
held.message: Write a subject and a message, or use the composed words.
held.notWaiting: This re-promise no longer waits for sales.
held.ownProposal: You proposed this date: another person of sales gives the word (nobody decides their own request).
held.noDecide: Sales gives the word: it needs the right to change orders (orders.manage).
held.mayNotDecide: You cannot decide on this order.
held.noTell: Telling the customer needs the right to send mail (email.send).
held.noRecipient: The customer has no e-mail address on the order or its contacts.
held.notProposer: Only the planner who proposed it takes it back.
held.declineReason: Say why the new date is declined (the planner reads it).

problem.noPromise: No promise yet: record its first promise on the order.
problem.notCertified: Not certified for this size: it cannot be promised.
problem.message: Write a subject and a message.
problem.messageLong: The subject keeps to 200 characters and the message to 10,000.
problem.refused: Refused: no valid certificate covers this size on that day.

refusal.WAITING_EXISTS: A re-promise of this line already waits for sales: it is shown now.
refusal.NOT_WAITING: This re-promise no longer waits for sales: it was decided or taken back meanwhile.
refusal.OWN_PROPOSAL: Nobody decides their own re-promise: another person of sales gives the word.
refusal.NOT_PROPOSER: Only the planner who proposed it takes it back.
refusal.STALE: The promise changed since this re-promise was proposed: propose it again from the dates now.
refusal.NO_RECIPIENT: The customer has no e-mail address on the order or its contacts: accept without telling them here, or add an address on the order.
refusal.CERTIFICATE: Only sizes a valid certificate covers through their day can be promised: the size is marked.
refusal.changed: Someone changed this line meanwhile: it was read again.
refusal.invalid: The request was refused as it is.
refusal.sizes: A size’s day was refused: it is marked in its row.
refusal.reason: Pick a reason from the list.
refusal.declineReason: Say why the new date is declined.
refusal.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
refusal.gone: This line or proposal is no longer there.
refusal.offline: No connection: nothing was sent. Try again.
refusal.failed: It could not be done. Try again in a moment.

notice.proposed: The new date of {order} line {line} went to sales for acceptance.
notice.accepted: The new date of {order} line {line} is promised.
notice.acceptedTold: The new date of {order} line {line} is promised and the customer was told.
notice.declined: The re-promise of {order} line {line} was declined: the planner reads why.
notice.withdrawn: The re-promise of {order} line {line} was taken back.
notice.usedOnQuote: The suggested date is on quote {quote}.
notice.proposalGone: That re-promise is no longer there.

history.title: Promise history of {order}
history.typedOnly: Promised {day} as typed on the order; no change since.

repromise.title: Re-promise {order} · line {line}
repromise.sizesHint: The plan’s day is filled in where the plan moves a size; change it or clear it to keep that size’s promise.
repromise.reasonHint: The customer reads it in their words.
repromise.noteHint: For sales and the history; never sent to the customer.
repromise.noRecipients: The customer has no e-mail address yet: sales can accept without telling them here.
repromise.subject: Subject
repromise.noPreview: The words are composed when it is sent.
repromise.previewStale: Nexus writes the message again with the days and the reason you send.
repromise.whatHappensBody: Sales accepts or declines; on acceptance the customer sees the new date in the portal and gets the message.

decide.waiting: A re-promise waits for sales since {time}
decide.noAssignee: Sales’ task is not assigned yet
decide.tell: Tell the customer now by e-mail
decide.declineHint: The planner reads it; the customer does not.
decide.whatHappens: Accept: the new dates are promised, the order’s date follows and, if you tell them, the customer gets the message on the order’s thread. Decline: nothing changes and the planner reads why.

done.proposedBody: {who} gives the word; the line shows “Waits for sales” until then.
done.told: The customer was told by e-mail ({to}).
done.notTold: The customer was not told here.
done.lineDate: The order line’s date is now {day}.
done.declinedBody: Nothing changed; the planner reads why.
done.withdrawnBody: Nothing changed; a new re-promise can be proposed.

warning.NO_RELEASED_BOM: The style has no released bill of materials: material is not counted.
warning.REVISION_NOT_RELEASED: The revision is not released yet.
warning.NO_ROUTING: No routing: the make lead time of the items stands in.
warning.NO_LEAD_TIME: A material has no lead time on record: counted from today.
warning.NO_MAKE_LEAD_TIME: An item has no make lead time on record.
warning.PURCHASE_OVERDUE: A purchase order the date counts on is overdue.
warning.NO_LANE: No line or work centre does a step: it cannot be planned.
warning.NO_CAPACITY: Not enough capacity within the horizon.
warning.BEYOND_HORIZON: The date falls beyond the planning horizon.
warning.HELD_AT_SHIPMENT: Another rule would hold the shipment.
